title: Blocking Burnham shows Starmer’s ruthlessness cannot mask his weakness
summary: NEC’s move merely postpones rather than resolves questions about who can lead Labour’s fightback It is a sign that the political deck of cards is stacked against you when the only good hand is one that was never really going to be dealt. And so it was with Keir Starmer and Andy Burnham. In an ideal world for the prime minister, Andrew Gwynne’s announcement that he was stepping down from his Gorton and Denton seat would have been followed by Burnham saying he already had a job as Greater Manchester mayor and would sit this one out, thanks very much. title: Online fundraiser for Alex Pretti raises nearly $400,000 day after fatal shooting
summary: GoFundMe platform surpasses goal of $20,000 a day after federal agents killed the US citizen in Minneapolis An online fundraiser benefiting the family of Alex Pretti had raised nearly $400,000 by Sunday morning, a day after federal agents killed the US citizen and nurse in Minneapolis in a shooting that ignited another round of street protests against Donald Trump’s administration and its immigration crackdown in the city. In a substantial indication of public sentiment, the “Alex Pretti is an American Hero” campaign on the GoFundMe platform surpassed its goal of $20,000 quickly after organizer Keith Edwards launched it Saturday.
